title: Would Not Buy This Model Again
text: Would Not Buy This Model Again. I wish I would have bought a better model. The steam is not strong no matter how much you pump the handle. It is definitely light and easy to maneuver but that is about all the good things I can say about it. They don't last much longer than three years no matter how well you take care of it so I'll keep it till it goes out and then buy a better model. I've owned sharks since they first came out and this is my fourth one so I speak the truth about short their life spam is.

product_metadata.title: Shark Light and Easy Steam Mop (S3251)
features: Washable microfiber pads that lift up and lock away dirt & debris
Safe on sealed hard floor surfaces
description: The Shark Light and Easy Steam Mop is lightweight and easy-to-use for quick and simple cleaning. With the Shark Light and Easy Steam Mop you will turn ordinary water into super-heated steam to remove everyday dirt and grime that other mops leave behind. Featuring swivel steering, a telescoping handle, and an ergonomic design, the Shark Light and Easy Steam Mop makes quick work of cleaning around furniture. Chemical free super-heated steam deep cleans, providing 99. 9% sanitization, so you can feel confident that your floors are both germ-free and chemical-free.
